checks: Early RMT report selection survives every stream update, without checkbox/highlight flicker or result-list rollback.
Image and lightbox loading use a reserved RMT XSpinner slot; title, arrows and details keep identical geometry; native fullscreen remains intact.
About backdrop follows the neutral warm palette in both schemes.
Truncated and malformed NDJSON preserve already displayed results, terminate the spinner and forbid cache capture.
A newer direct search cancels stale frames; all final results belong to the current generation.
An eight-second lazy-import deadline clears the spinner; image navigation invalidates the old import and cannot reopen a stale fullscreen view.
scope: Built candidate with isolated offline providers; explicit stream fault injection; no live queries or production settings.
